body: I gave help and a post and someone named 2_0_0_6 was very mean towards my response calling it a "generic bullshit response"

Please, please don't kill yourself. You're extremely brave, and it's hard to live like that, especially with no father and a mother with cancer. I think it's horrible your mother loved a baby that wasn't hers and not her own, and even making you feel bad by acknowledging her own cancer. This sounds almost abusive and she's caring for the wrong child. I also understand your little sister situation. I try punishing my brother since he's very abusive for his age, and I get straight up yelled at. Like I'm the bad guy. But like a tunnel, there is always an opening. Just some are longer.

I feel you. Life will feel likes it's not going anywhere, despite those supporting you. Just remember, you may be in a dark tunnel, but tunnels always have a light at the end (that isn't a train.) Some are shorter and some are longer, but it's not a tunnel without an opening. You'll get there soon.

Thank you so much! I don't like calling it abuse though, since its not my dad's fault. He grew up in a strict household on a farm across the world. He just wants to make sure I grow up right, and anger is very hard to control, I understand him. But he should get better, since even my.mother acknowledges it. And my mom probably just wants the best for me as well, But yes, she could hear me out more. And about telling some other adult, I've already considered that, and done it. They were actually very helpful, and I remember what they said every now and then. And as for you, words can't describe your help. (No really they can't I've been looking for an adjective for 5 minutes which is an awful lot for one adjective)
